## Pushed for review — Gerrit change 2361

`https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2361` — "Stop gating op-certs on signing
environment", commit `f868716946a4`, branched from `origin/main` `ae4f6c1a07a9`.
`rebar-ticket: c21f-6f29-5d2d-4a5a`, DCO signed. Not submitted; awaiting `LLM-Review +1` and
`Verified +1`.

### Local verification before push

- `make lint` (incl. the module-size and complexity ratchets) — clean.
- `make typecheck` — clean, 684 files.
- Targeted suite across every affected surface (`-k "sign or opcert or attest or claim or gate or
  plan_review or identity or verify or trusted"` over `tests/unit` + `tests/interfaces`):
  **3687 passed**, 2 failed, both caught by the MCP schema-drift gate — `VerifySignatureResultOut`
  and the `VerifySignatureResult` TypedDict under-declared the new `trust_basis` property. Fixed by
  declaring it in `src/rebar/_mcp_models.py` and `src/rebar/types.py`; the drift gate now passes
  6/6 and the core suites are 33/33.
- The full `make test` was not run to completion locally: this host is at load ~29 from other
  concurrent agent worktrees and the serial run reached only 6% in ~40 minutes. CI's `Verified`
  gate is the authority on the full suite, per the landing policy.

### Bugfix-size gate

The change is ~270 non-test diff lines, over the 150-line floor, so `bugfix-size-attestation`
applies. The attestation was earned properly — `review-plan` PASS, signed, locally certified — not
dodged by shrinking the change, and no `--force` or gate override of any kind was used anywhere in
this session.
